from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document for matching against the list of judgment results."""
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court issuing the judgment")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific case numbers mentioned in the document")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="List of party names (appellants, appellees, respondents, etc.)")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
    ruling_disposition: str | None = Field(description="The main legal disposition or outcome (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    monetary_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts or fees mentioned in the ruling")
    key_locations: list[str] = Field(description="Specific addresses, regions, or property identifiers mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List of extracted facts for each provided document")
